items.detail: Stevens made both of his field-goal attempts and his only PAT during Sunday's 20-13 loss to the Rams.

items.name: Austin Ekeler
items.detail: Ekeler rushed eight times for 16 yards and caught two of three targets for 18 yards during Sunday's 20-13 loss to the Rams.

items.name: Van Jefferson
items.detail: Jefferson caught five of seven targets for 58 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 20-13 loss to the Rams.

items.name: Stefon Diggs
items.detail: Diggs caught three of five targets for 51 yards in Sunday's 20-13 loss to the Rams.

items.name: Rachaad White
items.detail: White carried the ball seven times for 28 yards and caught two of three targets for 41 yards in Sunday's 20-13 loss to the Rams.

items.name: Jayden Daniels
items.detail: Daniels completed 24 of 35 passes for 274 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 20-13 loss to the Rams. He also gained 16 rushing yards on four carries and lost a fumble.

items.name: Jer'Zhan Newton
items.detail: Newton (pectoral) is active for Sunday's game against the Rams.

items.name: Dyami Brown
items.detail: The Commanders placed Brown (calf) on injured reserve Saturday.

items.name: Daron Payne
items.detail: Payne (foot) underwent season-ending surgery Wednesday, Ben Standig of The Team 980 Washington D.C. reports.

items.name: Jeremy McNichols
items.detail: McNichols, who suffered a foot injury Sunday against the Eagles that may require surgery, is out for the season, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.
